notes.title: Update Notes for June 22
notes.content:
Controls for a WASD configuration have been added. This makes enables remote play to work with WASD controls for one player while the second player can use the mouse to move the second player.

Game has also been tested to work with Ubuntu Linux. The start ".sh" file is non functional in the Ubuntu Linux system but the main Java .jar file executes just fine. To fix this launch configuration for now and assuming Java JRE is installed in Linux and Mac OS systems just navigate to the steam installation folder for Brendon's Water Polo and then navigate to the "BWP_v1_3" folder then the "lib" folder. Double clicking the runnable BWP_v1_3.jar file should run the game on the system. This error doesn't affect Windows systems.
